verdicts.rationale: The sole divergence hint is C4 raising each Lightning Rose tick from 1 to 1-3 discharges, a probabilistic Markov-chain bolt-count increase — a damage-magnitude / hit-count concern that is constitution-excluded (damage numbers/math) and has no probabilistic-proc primitive, so it is not implementable. The Lightning Rose summon and its 15s of periodic ticks already render on the timeline; the number of bolts each tick fires does not change any rotation, buff/heal, or cooldown decision, and a player who knows C4 is a damage boost is not misled by the tick display. Fails the purpose test — default noCaveat.
rubricRefs: Out of scope by constitution: damage numbers/math
Multi-hit swings collapse to one hit

groundedIn.claim: C4 changes each tick from 1 to 1-3 discharges, count is probabilistic (Markov chain), and the effect is not modeled
groundedIn.quote: C4: each Lightning Rose tick fires 1–3 discharges instead of 1, count is probabilistic based on enemy count and prior discharge count (Markov chain). Effect not modeled — needs reviewer pass.

groundedIn.claim: The Lightning Rose summon's periodic ticks already render across the 15s window on the timeline
groundedIn.quote: Periodic ticks ('Lightning Rose (Tick)') start at firstTick=119, every 30 frames for 900 frames (15s). spawnsAt set to 119 per recipe burst-loop guidance

groundedIn.claim: The in-game C4 description frames the change purely as the number of lightning bolts unleashed on attack
groundedIn.quote: Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.
